Rules / Formatting

SK0212 The accessibility modifier is not arranged

skala arrange would omit an accessibility modifier that matches the language default.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

The rule knows the language-defined default for each declaration kind and removes only an explicitly written modifier equal to it. It does not infer project API policy.

Example

Instead of:

private int value;

Write:

int value;

When it does not fire

Only modifiers identical to the C# default for that declaration are removed.

Configuration

  • dotnet_style_require_accessibility_modifiers
